content:
Sync with  landing  page  too # IVX INVESTMENT CARD UPGRADE — COPY FULL OLD DETAILS INTO NEW DESIGN + TIMELINE + FINAL QA

MODE: EXECUTE NOW
PRIORITY: P0 UI / DEAL DATA
GOAL: Keep the new investment-card design, but restore all complete investment information and timeline details from the old card, then test and deploy end to end.

OWNER DESIGN DECISION:

- KEEP the new card visual design.
- DO NOT return to the old card layout.
- COPY the complete investment details from the old card into the new card.
- ADD the investment timeline.
- Preserve View Deal and Invest Now.
- Do not remove existing categories, actions, image carousel, or status badges.

==================================================
1 — AUDIT OLD CARD DATA
==================================================

Inspect the old investment card and identify every field it displayed.

Required old-card fields to preserve:

- Property/deal title
- Location
- Status
- Sale price
- Total investment amount
- ROI
- Timeline
- Minimum investment
- Minimum ownership percentage
- Fractional investment starting amount
- Ownership at minimum investment
- Developer/company name
- Development/company icon
- Details section
- Invest Now
- Up to 8 property images
- Image counter
- Categories:
  - Tokenized
  - JV Deal
  - Buyer
- Like
- Comment
- Save
- Share

Return the exact old component file and data field mapping.

==================================================
2 — KEEP THE NEW CARD DESIGN
==================================================

The approved new card must remain the base design.

Do not replace it with the old card.

Use the current new card structure:

- Large property image
- Status badge
- Title
- Location
- ROI
- Categories
- Engagement actions
- View Deal
- Invest Now

Extend this card with the missing information.

==================================================
3 — ADD INVESTMENT SUMMARY PANEL
==================================================

Add a clean investment summary section inside the new card.

Required fields:

SALE PRICE
- Example: $3.13M

TOTAL INVESTMENT
- Example: $2.50M

ROI
- Example: 25%

TIMELINE
- Example: 12–18 months
- Must not remain blank

MINIMUM INVESTMENT
- Example: From $50.00

MINIMUM OWNERSHIP
- Example: 0.0016%

DEVELOPER
- Example: ONE STOP DEVELOPMENT LLC

Use production data only.

Do not hardcode the example values.

==================================================
4 — ADD INVESTMENT TIMELINE
==================================================

Add a visible timeline section.

Required timeline stages:

1. Acquisition / Closing
2. Permits / Design
3. Construction Start
4. Structural / Rough Work
5. Interior Finishes
6. Final Inspection
7. Sale / Refinance / Distribution

Each stage must support:

- stage name
- start date
- estimated completion date
- actual completion date
- status
- percent complete
- optional note

Allowed statuses:

- UPCOMING
- ACTIVE
- DELAYED
- COMPLETE

Display timeline summary on the card:

- estimated total duration
- current stage
- completion percentage
- estimated completion date

Add full timeline details inside the expanded Details section or Deal Detail screen.

==================================================
5 — DATA CONTRACT
==================================================

Audit the backend/API model and add or map these fields:

- sale_price
- investment_required
- roi_percent
- minimum_investment
- minimum_ownership_percent
- investment_timeline_months
- current_timeline_stage
- project_completion_percent
- estimated_completion_date
- developer_name
- developer_logo
- investment_details
- timeline_stages

Do not duplicate fields if equivalent fields already exist.

Use one canonical field mapping.

==================================================
6 — EMPTY AND INVALID DATA HANDLING
==================================================

Do not show blank labels such as:

Timeline

with no value.

Required behavior:

- If timeline exists, show real value.
- If timeline is missing, show:
  `Timeline pending verification`
- If a numeric value is missing, show:
  `Not available`
- Never show `null`, `undefined`, `NaN`, or empty spaces.
- Never invent financial values.

==================================================
7 — CARD LAYOUT
==================================================

Required order inside the new card:

1. Image carousel
2. Status badge
3. Title
4. Location
5. Main financial summary
6. Timeline summary
7. Minimum investment / ownership
8. Categories
9. Developer
10. Details button
11. View Deal
12. Invest Now
13. Like / comment / save / share

The layout must remain compact and readable.

Do not make the card excessively tall.

Use collapsible Details for secondary information.

==================================================
8 — RESPONSIVE DESIGN
==================================================

Test on:

- Small Android phone
- Large Android phone
- Android tablet
- iPhone viewport
- Mobile web
- Desktop web

Verify:

- no clipped text
- no overlapping buttons
- no bottom-tab overlap
- no horizontal overflow
- no broken image ratio
- no blank timeline
- no hidden financial fields
- no excessive card height

==================================================
9 — DEAL DETAIL PARITY
==================================================

The Deal Detail screen must show the same canonical values as the card:

- Sale price
- Total investment
- ROI
- Timeline
- Minimum investment
- Minimum ownership
- Developer
- Full investment description
- Timeline stages
- Current progress
- Documents
- View Deal / Invest Now flow

Card and Deal Detail must not disagree.

==================================================
10 — QA EVERY DATA SOURCE
==================================================

For each production deal test:

1. Jacksonville Prime
2. Casa Rosario
3. One Stop Development / Perez Residence
4. Casa Rosario Reel
5. Any additional active deal

Return:

- deal ID
- API route
- sale price
- investment amount
- ROI
- timeline
- minimum investment
- minimum ownership
- developer
- card render
- Deal Detail render
- PASS/FAIL

==================================================
11 — AUTOMATED TESTS
==================================================

Add tests for:

- new card keeps approved design
- sale price renders
- total investment renders
- ROI renders
- timeline renders
- timeline fallback renders
- minimum investment renders
- minimum ownership renders
- developer renders
- Details expands
- timeline stages render
- View Deal works
- Invest Now works
- no null/undefined text
- card and Deal Detail values match
- image carousel supports 8 pictures
- small-screen layout does not clip

==================================================
12 — DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After tests pass:

1. Run lint.
2. Run typecheck.
3. Run unit tests.
4. Run integration tests.
5. Run card tests.
6. Run Deal Detail tests.
7. Build Expo production app.
8. Commit.
9. Push.
10. Deploy backend if data contract changed.
11. Deploy landing page.
12. Publish Expo/EAS update or new APK if native UI changed.
13. Verify production.

==================================================
13 — LIVE QA
==================================================

Verify on production:

- Home new card design remains
- Complete investment details are visible
- Timeline is visible
- Details opens
- View Deal opens correct deal
- Invest Now opens correct flow
- no infinite loading
- no blank timeline
- no mismatched values
- no old card restored
- no layout regression
